description: This file defines the `Marshaler` class for marshaling and unmarshaling JSON and PHP arrays to and from DynamoDB items within the AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: Marshaler
classes.description: Handles marshaling and unmarshaling of data between PHP types and DynamoDB attribute values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Marshaler with optional configuration options.

methods.name: binary
methods.description: Creates a BinaryValue object for binary data.

methods.name: number
methods.description: Creates a NumberValue object for numeric data.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Creates a SetValue object for set data.

methods.name: marshalJson
methods.description: Converts a JSON string into a DynamoDB item.

methods.name: marshalItem
methods.description: Converts a PHP array or object into a DynamoDB item.

methods.name: marshalValue
methods.description: Converts a PHP value into a DynamoDB attribute value.

methods.name: unmarshalJson
methods.description: Converts a DynamoDB item into a JSON string.

methods.name: unmarshalItem
methods.description: Converts a DynamoDB item into a PHP array or object.

methods.name: unmarshalValue
methods.description: Converts a DynamoDB attribute value into a PHP value.

methods.name: handleInvalid
methods.description: Handles invalid values based on the marshaler's configuration.
